final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM j) AS share FROM j) SELECT mix AS ordertypedist, cnt AS behaviour_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS above_baseline FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
